page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.2xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed family and is built on KVM virtualization using the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs spread across 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance configuration is balanced with 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per vCPU). The underlying processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports specialized vector extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16.

The hardware configuration features zero local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. Storage requires external network-attached block volumes. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance. System memory bandwidth demonstrates standard throughput, reaching 463.02 GB/s in cached 16 KB read workloads, 52.83 GB/s across uncached 256 MB reads, and 34.66 GB/s for 256 MB write cycles.

Performance benchmarks place the instance largely in the average tier across general compute and memory tasks. It posts a Geekbench multi-core score of 4,891.0 and a single-core score of 1,254.0, while PassMark yields a CPU score of 9,399.28. In application-focused metrics, Redis SET throughput reaches 7.65 million operations per second, and static web serving achieves 7.0 GB/s. However, specific compute loads show weaknesses; bzip3 multi-threaded decompression (33.28 GB/s), PassMark physics (824.8), and Geekbench image processing (3,660.0) fall into the lower quartile. Furthermore, running a 7B LLM on the CPU exhibits poor throughput, managing 11.62 prompt tokens per second and 5.76 generation tokens per second.

Given its dedicated high-frequency CPU cores, vector instructions, and balanced memory allocation, the ecs.hfg7.2xlarge is suited for standard production environments that do not require local NVMe drives. Recommended workloads include relational databases, Redis caching layers, web serving, software compilation pipelines, and mid-tier backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.2xlarge is a high clock speed, general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 32.0 GB of RAM, and a 3 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no local storage or GPUs, requiring attached network volumes for persistent storage. Compute benchmarks show balanced middle-tier results, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 4,891.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 9,399.28, alongside 7.65 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.0 GB/s web serving throughput. Complex compression, physics, and CPU-based LLM inference are comparatively weak. The instance is suited for general backend applications, compilation pipelines, in-memory caches, and database servers.
